run_preprocess_iwslt17: run the CLI to preprocess IWSLT17 fr-en bitext with BPE, BBPE, byte, or char vocab options
run_pretokenize: run MosesTokenizer to pretokenize a text file for source and target language pairs
run_get_bpe: run SentencePiece to train a BPE model on concatenated training data with a given vocab size
run_apply_bbpe: run ByteBPE tokenizer to encode text lines using a trained SentencePiece byte-level BPE model
run_apply_bpe: run SentencepieceBPE tokenizer to encode text lines using a trained SentencePiece BPE model
